Callout.Name: Disturbance at a Metro Station
Callout.Message: Disturbance at a metro station, staff asking for attendance.

Script.Line: It is one man and he is walking the platform shouting at people.
Staff have stopped the trains on this side. That is why everybody is stuck.
He has a bag and he will not put the bag down.

Lines.Approach: Three of them and the staff want them out. No weapons mentioned.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
